description: Engine refinements on top of the catalogue (DECISIONS D15-D29, docs/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md). Kept out of retrofit_catalogue.json so pipelines/build_catalogue.py never overwrites them.

boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.basis: EPC main-heating rating used as a proxy for boiler type: Very Good/Good ~ condensing, Average ~ non-condensing 1998+, Poor/Very Poor ~ older non-condensing or back boiler. Values approximate the SAP Table 4b default seasonal efficiencies (condensing ~84-89%, non-condensing 1998+ ~73-74%, pre-1998 ~65%); Good = 0.85 keeps the cat-v3 default.
boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.verify_against: SAP 10.2 Table 4b (BRE); values not checked against the table text in this build
boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.used_for: useful heat delivered by the existing boiler (heat-pump replacement electricity). Fabric and controls gas savings do not depend on it (the efficiency cancels).

electric_heating.efficiency_basis: direct-acting and storage electric heating deliver ~100% of the electricity as heat at the point of use (assumption)

segment_impacts.method: empirical Bayes: deviation of each segment median from the headline median, shrunk by w = tau^2 / (tau^2 + se^2); se of a median = 1.2533 x (IQR / 1.349) / sqrt(n); tau^2 = max(0, variance of segment deviations - mean se^2) per measure x dimension. Shrunken deviations of the home's segments (EPC band, age, type, region) are added to every impact level and the result is floored at 0.
segment_impacts.age_rule: midpoint of the EPC age band (single year for one-year bands; 'before 1900' = Pre 1919) placed in the first NEED band whose upper year it does not exceed
segment_impacts.combine_note: region adjustment + the single largest non-region adjustment (EPC band, age and type are correlated, so adding them double-counts, D15 rev.); replaced by backfitted additive effects when configs/engine_calibration.json provides them

heat_pump_scop.source: Energy Systems Catapult, Electrification of Heat demonstration, interim heat pump performance data analysis (2023): median SPF 2.80 for air-source heat pumps across home types; median COP 2.44 on cold days
heat_pump_scop.note: low = cold-day median (conservative for an annual figure); high = catalogue assumption 3.5 (no field upper quantile found)

smart_thermostat_by_controls.basis: brief range 5-10% of space-heat demand: homes with no controls gain most, homes with programmer + room thermostat + TRVs least

loft.basis: 270 mm is the current recommended loft insulation depth (Building Regulations Approved Document L / Energy Saving Trust guidance); assumption

planning.pre_1919_note: pre-1919 home: check conservation-area and listed-building status before external wall insulation or roof-mounted PV (York has many conservation areas)

costs.reference_floor_area: from configs/engine_calibration.json (York median floor area); no size scaling until built
